name: qurl
description: Share an app running on your machine privately from Codex with qURL: no deploy, no account, no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Share your local app privately: no deploy, no account
interface.longDescription: Share an app, API or site running on your machine with a person or another agent, privately, without deploying it or opening a port. No account, API key or signup. Includes the qURL agent skill and two commands: $qurl:share and $qurl:approve.
defaultPrompt: Share the app I'm working on privately with qURL.
